Four

Four years of choosing Olajire 
every single day.

This is everything I have been meaning to say, the gratitude I should have said louder, the apologies I owe you properly, and every promise I intend to keep.

✦

Chapter one

Thank you for four years of real love.

Four years. That's 1,461 mornings. And in every single one of them, you chose to stay not because it was easy, but because you decided I was worth it. That decision is the most precious thing anyone could ever give.

You loved me through my worst days, my quietest days, my most difficult days. You held space for me when I didn't even know I needed holding. You saw the parts of me I hide from everyone else, and you stayed.

Thank you. For all of it. For being you, exactly as you are.

Chapter three · the hardest part

I owe you a real sorry.

Not a quick sorry to end an argument. Not a sorry because I got caught. A real, sitting-with-it, I-see-what-I-did apology. Because you deserve nothing less.

  • i.I am sorry for the times I made you feel like too much, you were never too much. You were exactly enough, and I was just too small in those moments to hold it all with grace.
  • ii.I am sorry for the silences that lasted longer than they should have. For choosing pride over peace, and making you wait for me to come back when you'd done nothing wrong.
  • iii.I am sorry for the times I wasn't fully present when I was there in body but somewhere else in mind. You deserved all of me, not the leftover parts.
  • iv.I am sorry for the moments I took your love for granted. For not saying thank you enough.For forgetting that you were giving me something sacred every single day, and I walked past it sometimes without even noticing.
  • v.I'm sorry for every single tear I caused that I could have prevented. You didn't deserve that. And I carry it.
A moment I wish I'd done better
But you stayed
✦

Chapter four

What I promise you, now and always.

These aren't words for a good moment. These are the things I'm committing to even when it's hard, especially when it's hard.

♡I promise to show up fully in conversation, in conflict, in celebration. All of me, not the curated version.
♡I promise to say sorry faster and mean it deeper. No more waiting days for something that deserved minutes.
♡I promise to keep choosing you, not just when it feels easy, but when it demands the best of me.
♡I promise to be your safe place, to hold your fears with both hands and never make you feel silly for having them.
♡I promise to grow with you, not just alongside you. To let your growth make me better and to celebrate every version of you that emerges.
♡I promise to never stop telling you how loved you are, how seen you are, how lucky I am to have you. Every day. Not just on the special ones.

Chapter five · what I'm asking

Let me do right by you -now and for everything that comes after.

I know I haven't always been the person you needed me to be. I know there have been moments where my love felt like it wasn't enough, or wasn't showing up the right way. And I carry that with me.

But I am standing here in all my imperfection, with all my lessons learned, asking you to believe in what we are building. Not the past version of us. The one we are building right now.

Give me the chance to love you the way you've always deserved to be loved. Give me the chance to be someone you never have to doubt. Not because I'm asking for forgiveness, but because I genuinely want to be better, and you make me want to be better.

Four years in, and I am more sure of you than I have ever been of anything. I don't want to just keep going, I want to go deeper. Further. Better.

Will you let me? Please click button below, if you will.

That means everything to me. I won't take it lightly. Ever.
"Four years ago I found a love I didn't know I needed.
Today I know I can't live without it, 
and I don't ever intend to."
— with every part of me
